abstract: The outcome for 84 patients in different stages of non-seminomatous germinal cell tumours of the testicle and treated with Mithramycin as a single agent has been evaluated. The survival rate in patients with advanced disease was lower than that obtained by more aggressive chemotherapy and, therefore, in these stages Mithramycin therapy is not recommended. On the other hand, the survival rate in patients with low-stage disease was superior to that in other series of patients subjected to bilateral lymphadenectomy without subsequent adjuvant chemotherapy. In the present study a unilateral gland dissection with preservation of a normal sexual function was performed in the vast majority of patients. Single-drug chemotherapy should preferably be used only as adjuvant treatment in low-stage non-seminomatous germinal cell testicular tumours.
abstract_ja: 精巣の非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍患者84例に対し、単剤のミトラマイシンで治療した経過を評価した。進行期の患者では、より積極的な化学療法を受けた場合よりも生存率が低く、進行期ではミトラマイシン療法は推奨されない。一方、低病期の患者の生存率は、両側リンパ節郭清を受けたが補助化学療法は行わなかった既報の症例群よりも良好だった。ほとんどの症例で、性機能を温存しつつ片側の精巣摘除術を施行した。低病期の精巣非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍では、単剤療法は補助化学療法としてのみ用いるべきと考えられる。
